proposal_rules.title: Operationalize Name-Collision Tie-Break For Inbox Outreach
proposal_rules.hypothesis: When duplicate contact names are resolved through an explicit, ordered evidence ladder, agents will avoid false clarifications and complete actionable inbox outreach with `OUTCOME_OK` when exactly one candidate is supportable.
proposal_rules.change: Replace the current one-line duplicate-name instruction with an include-backed micro-procedure: (1) build candidates by exact full-name match, (2) extract intent cues from the inbox action text, (3) score candidates only with explicit repository evidence from canonical account/contact/reminder metadata, (4) proceed only if one candidate remains; otherwise return `OUTCOME_NONE_CLARIFICATION`. Require grounding refs to include both cue source and winning identity/account source files.
